definitions.short: to forage for straw , stubble or wood ; figuratively, to assemble
definitions.full: H7197. qashash [ קָשַׁשׁ ] verb denominative Po`el gather stubble ; — Perfect 3plural consecutive וְקשְׁשׁוּ Exod 5:7 ; Infinitive construct לְקשֵׁשׁ 5:12 ; Participle מְקשֵׁשׁ Num 15:32-33 , feminine מְקשֶׁשֶׁת 1Kin 17:10 , 12 ; — gather stubble , with accusative of congnate meaning with verb קַשׁ Exod 5:12 ( לַתֶּבֶן ); also with accusative תֶּבֶן 5:7 (both J); with accusative עֵצִים as firewood Num 15:32-33 , (P) 1Kin 17:10 , 12 . II. [ קָשַׁשׁ ] doubtful verb , only Qal Imperative + Hithpo`el Imperative , וָקוֺשּׁוּ הִתְקוֺשְׁשׁוּ Zeph 2:1 ; AV RV gather yourselves together, yea gather together , from foregoing (compare Vrss), but this only denominative in specific meaning gather stubble, sticks , etc.; read probably with Gr Bu SK 1893, 396 and others הִתְבּוֺשְׁשׁוּ .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; to become sapless through drought; used only as denominative from 7179 ;
